name: gather_wood
description: Collect at least 30 Wood by cutting nearby trees.
task: Hold at least 30 Wood (any kind: Wood, BorealWood, PalmWood...).

name: obtain_boreal_workbench
description: Gather enough BorealWood and craft a single BorealWoodWorkBench.
task: Hold a work bench (any wood variant counts, e.g. BorealWoodWorkBench).

name: craft_wooden_hammer_simple
description: Craft one WoodenHammer using existing Wood and a WorkBench.
task: Hold a wooden hammer (any wood variant counts).

name: mine_more_stone
description: Dig down to find stone and mine 27 more StoneBlock tiles.
